referencePaper: Benjamin E. Diamond (2026), Hodge Structures in Sextic Fourfolds Equipped with an Involution, arXiv:2603.29157v2
governingPDE: F^(q+1) | (A - q * dF(v) + F * div(v)) in Q[Z_0..Z_5]_(F) for v = W / D, D not in (F)

exactVerifiedMechanisms.lemma_3_6_partial_euler_quotient_rule: Verified in Lean 4 (DiamondGriffithsLewisPDE.lean) and Python symbolic algebra (hodge_sextics_solver.py): whenever F = F_I + F_{I^c} is uncoupled across a subset I with deg_I(A) + |I| = 6, the rational vector field v = (A * nu_I) / (q * dF(nu_I)) satisfies A - q*dF(v) + F*div(v) = 0 identically.
exactVerifiedMechanisms.second_order_jacobian_coupling_correctio: Verified in Lean 4 (coupled_sextic_second_order_jacobian_correction): when cross-block coupling creates a nonzero defect E = D*(nu_I(A) + |I|*A) - nu_I(D)*A, adding the F-proportional correction (F/q)*mu reduces the PDE modulo F^2 to E = (q-1)*D*dF(mu) mod F.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Broken paired signs
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Sign asymmetry breaks the direct GL_3 block transport from Fermat.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Use weighted diagonal derivation nu_w = sum w_i Z_i d/dZ_i matched to the paired sign blocks, plus second-order Jacobian correction mu.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Dense rational · full coefficient support
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: All 462 degree-6 monomials are active; naive Macaulay linear system for (W, D) exceeds memory.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Apply waring_coreset_cohomology_pairing_invariance (Discovery 02): project modulo J(F)_6 first and prune candidate vector-field basis blocks to a (k+1)-element apolar coreset.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Cyclic coupling · pole order two
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Order-2 pole (q=1) with cyclic Z/3Z cross-block coupling terms.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Decompose into Z/3Z character sectors via equivariant_certificate_symmetrization (3x Macaulay reduction) and choose D = dF(nu_cyclic) invariant under the cyclic generator.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Polarized split · K3 remainder
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Split sextic component is solved, leaving a K3-type middle-cohomology remainder at q=2.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Use the 3+3 block partial Euler derivation nu_{0,1,2} (verified in test_03 of hodge_sextics_solver.py) to annihilate the split sector, then apply coupled_sextic_second_order_jacobian_correction at q=2 on the K3 remainder.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Coupled Klein · nontrivial character
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Klein 4-group V_4 = Z/2Z x Z/2Z symmetry with target A in a nontrivial character sector.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Apply equivariant_certificate_symmetrization with the V_4 character projector Pi_chi (8x total dimension reduction when combined with sigma), reducing the degree-7 numerator space from 6*792 = 4,752 unknowns to ~594 unknowns.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Permutation symmetry · residual sector
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: S_3 permutation symmetry on (U_0,U_1,U_2) and (V_0,V_1,V_2); residual non-trivial representation.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Project onto the 2D standard / 1D sign S_3 character sectors (6x Macaulay matrix reduction) and use symmetric partial Euler sums.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Rank-one coupling · biquartic pencil
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Rank-one coupling term L(U)^2 * Q(V)^4 or biquartic interaction breaks block separation.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Choose nu in ker(dL) (a 5-dimensional subspace of partial Euler fields annihilating the rank-1 linear form L), which forces the rank-1 coupling to behave as a pure block term under nu!

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Four plus two · suspension remainder
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: 4+2 variable split (quaternary sextic + binary sextic suspension).
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Use I = {4, 5} (the 2-variable binary suspension block, where binary_sextic_factorization_identity factors the binary sextic completely into 6 linear forms) and apply Lemma 3.6 on the 2-variable block.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Quadric contact · residual sector
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: F has contact along a quadric Q = 0 (F = Q^3 + R or Q*G + H).
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Use Hamiltonian / Lie-Of-Quadric vector fields nu in so(Q) satisfying dQ(nu) = 0, so nu differentiates only the residual contact cofactor.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: One reflection · skew coupling
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Z/2Z reflection with skew-symmetric cross-coupling (8 partial results already found on leaderboard).
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Split into +/-1 reflection eigenspaces via projPlus/projMinus (HodgeSexticCertificateAndWaringBridge.lean) and apply the q=2 Jacobian defect cancellation formula.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Reflection · complementary character
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Complementary odd character sector under a single coordinate reflection.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Project W onto the odd reflection sector Pi_- while keeping the denominator D = dF(nu_+) in the even sector Pi_+ so W/D has the exact required parity.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Cyclic triple cover · complementary character
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Z/3Z cyclic cover in the non-trivial character eigenspace.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Use Z/3Z character idempotent projection (3x Macaulay reduction) and cyclic partial Euler combinations.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Eight powers · linear-section remainder
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Waring rank 8 (sum of 8 sixth powers L_1^6 + ... + L_8^6 on P^5, exceeding the 6-coordinate Fermat basis by 2 dependent linear forms).
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Change coordinates so L_1..L_6 are Z_0..Z_5 and L_7, L_8 are linear combinations. To eliminate the 2 extra powers L_7^6 and L_8^6 from dF(nu), choose the 4-dimensional subspace of linear derivations nu in gl_6(Q) satisfying dL_7(nu) = 0 and dL_8(nu) = 0! On that subspace, dF(nu) reduces to a pure 6-power Fermat form!

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Quadratic pullback · residual density
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Pullback of a cubic F_3(Q_0, ..., Q_5) under quadratic forms Q_i (even exponents only).
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: All exponents in F and A are even, reducing the monomial support to the even-exponent lattice (8x smaller Macaulay system). Apply partial Euler fields aligned with the quadratic blocks.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Eight planes · contact arrangement
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Arrangement of 8 planes with contact relations.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Use logarithmic vector fields tangent to subsets of 4 coplanar/concurrent planes so dL_r(nu) = lambda_r L_r.

open16InstancesAnalysis.title: Simultaneous permutations · standard sector
open16InstancesAnalysis.structuralObstruction: Diagonal S_3 action permuting (U_0,U_1,U_2) and (V_0,V_1,V_2) simultaneously, projected to the 2D standard representation.
open16InstancesAnalysis.attackStrategyFromOurBridges: Combine S_3 standard-representation projection with block-swap sigma anti-invariance (reducing the search dimension by 6x) and solve the resulting exact rational linear system in python-flint.
